dedupe_keys.name: rapid mayfield ky post tornado building reconnaissance

description: RAPID: Mayfield, KY Post-Tornado Building Reconnaissance is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Saanchi Singh Kaushal, Penn State University (psu.edu). In December 2021, an EF-4 tornado outbreak devastated the historic downtown district of Mayfield, Kentucky. This reconnaissance mission systematically documented the resulting damage to historic masonry buildings using digital data collection. The dataset combines terrestrial and UAV imagery, ground control points (GCPs), and terrestrial laser scanning to produce high-resolution photogrammetric and LiDAR point clouds. Coverage: Mayfield, KY. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: tornado, building reconnaissance, historic masonry, digital data collection, UAV imagery, LiDAR point clouds. Published 2023-09-01. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
